checks.finding: Warm is a separate address/Bytes32-key set. WarmRelated binds its pre-access membership to actual accessedStorageKeys and never substitutes Tx.reads. This agrees with source storage.py pre-access membership queries and state_tracker.get_storage BAL insertion.

Both sourceReading and closed inputs use source Parent plus source created metadata: created owner forces zero, otherwise parent writes/prestate. They do not use pinned sigma0 or pinned createdAccounts. Archived get_storage_original confirms this order.

Related supplies actual owner current slots and stack/environment equality. inputs reads slotW actual state, sourceReading reads source overlays; reading_eq proves equality. The new value uses the second top-first stack item, matching source key then value pops.

inputs is a closed function of fixed Parent/source created set and actual state. reading_eq is fieldwise and assumes only existing Related, WarmRelated and source created-set equality, not equality of desired readings/charges/refunds.
original_readTracked and original_write are exact because those updates leave source created and Parent unchanged; they do not assert original equals current or pinned original.

warmAfter defines successful SLOAD/SSTORE insertion only. This module does not claim initial warmth binding, actual step preservation, rollback equivalence, BAL mutation chronology on failure, or a coupled trace.

Initial warmth correspondence, created-set constancy along actions and actual warmAfter transport remain separate producers.
